sections.text_helper: Section 20.6.9 "TIMx counter (TIMx_CNT)(x = 16 to 17)" in chapter 20 (General-purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 619.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x24
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bit 31 UIFCPY: UIF Copy
This bit is a read-only copy of the UIF bit of the TIMx_ISR register. If the UIFREMAP bit in
TIMx_CR1 is reset, bit 31 is reserved and read as 0.
Bits 30:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 CNT[15:0]: Counter value
